name: pumi-halloween
description: A UI theme: pumi on Halloween night. Night purple lit in pumpkin orange, jack-o'-lanterns for working agents and ghosts for blocked ones, menus and questions on gravestones, and bats, cobwebs, fog and a spider over the window's edges. A ghost rises when an agent needs you and lightning strikes when one fails.

images.alt: pumi on Halloween night: a jack-o'-lantern tab at work, a ghost tab waiting, a gravestone question, bats and a spider on its web

critters.label: Bats, cobwebs and the spider
critters.desc: Bats crossing the top of the window, cobwebs in two corners and a spider on its thread.

fog.label: Fog
fog.desc: A faint fog drifting along the bottom of the window.

scares.label: Scares when agents change
scares.desc: A ghost rises when an agent needs you, lightning strikes when one fails, and bats fly out when one is done.

pane_outline.label: Outline the focused pane
pane_outline.desc: A pumpkin-orange edge on the pane with the focus.
